title: Existing-patient doctor question gets a brief answer before handoff
description: The caller says they already know the clinic and asks about terms with a named doctor, but does not provide identity details yet. The assistant should not jump straight into a dry handoff. It should first give one short operational answer that reception checks such doctor-specific terms, then ask only for the missing identity data and hand the case to reception without trying direct scheduling.

turns.user: Bylam juz u was. Chcialabym znowu umowic sie do doktora Kaluzy. Czy sa jakies wolne terminy w najblizszym czasie?

assertions.description: Without the caller identity details, the assistant should not create the reception task yet.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant skipped the missing-data step and created the handoff task too early

rubric.description: The assistant should first answer briefly that reception handles or checks doctor-specific terms.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant steamrolled past the caller question and skipped the short direct answer before handoff

rubric.description: After the brief answer, the assistant should move straight to the missing identity details.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant answered the doctor question but did not continue efficiently into the handoff data capture

rubric.description: The doctor-specific existing-patient question should not enter direct scheduling.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to check direct doctor availability instead of routing the case to reception

rubric.description: Once the caller provides identity details, the assistant should create the handoff task.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant failed to hand the doctor-specific follow-up to reception after collecting the missing details

rubric.description: The handoff should keep the existing_patient_booking task type.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant mapped the doctor-specific existing-patient follow-up to the wrong task type

rubric.description: The doctor-specific existing-patient request should create a reception task.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant prompt or handoff workflow did not create the reception task after the brief-answer path

rubric.description: This branch must not call checkAvailability.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant still tried to schedule the named doctor directly

rubric.description: This handoff branch must not create a booking directly.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant created a booking instead of routing the existing patient to reception
